whenToUse: Screens where people pick from a list and look closer, such as email, messaging, or settings.
People move quickly from item to item.
whenNotToUse: The details are very long and need focus (use a separate screen).
There are only a few items in the list.
Services used only on mobile (move from list to detail).

alternatives.name: Sidebar Layout
alternatives.reason: Separating a menu from the content.

alternatives.name: Back Navigation
alternatives.reason: Returning to the list on narrow screens.

accessibility: On narrow screens, the hidden side uses display: none, so it's also skipped by the keyboard and assistive technology.
The detail has a button back to the list.
The chosen item is marked with aria-current.
Because it uses a container query, it follows the same rules when placed inside a panel.
